arguments.resource:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: worker
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: agentic-cloud-ops
  name: worker
  namespace: agentic-ops
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: worker
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - |
          while true; do
            echo "$(date -Iseconds) worker tick"
            # Writes to the root filesystem. readOnlyRootFilesystem without
            # an emptyDir here is the second trap.
            echo ok > /tmp/heartbeat
            sleep 15
          done
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        name: worker
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 64Mi
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1000
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /tmp
          name: tmp
      volumes:
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: tmp
